dict.string: Mac Power Tools uses Automation to move files in Finder, send items to the Trash and open Terminal commands when you ask for Homebrew actions.
Mac Power Tools taps individual app audio only to adjust each app's volume in the mixer. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Mac Power Tools uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Mac Power Tools records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
Mac Power Tools shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Mac Power Tools checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose.
Mac Power Tools organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose.
